food_interactions.title: Alcohol
food_interactions.description: Avoid excessive alcohol consumption as it may increase the risk of liver damage when combined with paracetamol.

pregnancy_lactation.title: Pregnancy Safe
pregnancy_lactation.description: Generally considered safe during pregnancy and breastfeeding when taken at recommended doses.

drug_interactions.title: Warfarin
drug_interactions.description: Regular daily use of paracetamol may increase the blood-thinning effect of warfarin.

food_interactions.title: Alcohol
food_interactions.description: Alcohol increases the risk of lactic acidosis and can cause low blood sugar.

pregnancy_lactation.title: Pregnancy Consult
pregnancy_lactation.description: Consult your doctor. Insulin is generally preferred during pregnancy for blood sugar control.

drug_interactions.title: Iodinated Contrast Media
drug_interactions.description: Must be temporarily discontinued before imaging procedures involving iodinated contrast to prevent kidney issues.
